program.intent: Reversible transformation of complete timestamp with timezone to epoch microseconds.
program.code:
from datetime import datetime

def forward(groups):
    day, month, year, colon, time, space, tz_offset = groups
    dt_str = f"{day}/{month}/{year} {time} {tz_offset}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(dt_str, "%d/%b/%Y %H:%M:%S %z")
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': [len(space)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    space_len = layout[0]
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000).astimezone()
    dt_str = dt.strftime("%d/%b/%Y %H:%M:%S %z")
    day, month, year_time_tz = dt_str.split('/', maxsplit=1)
    year, time_tz = year_time_tz.split(' ', maxsplit=1)
    time, tz_offset = time_tz.rsplit(' ', maxsplit=1)
    return f"[{day}/{month}/{year}:{time}{' ' * space_len}{tz_offset}]"
